All cold people are white. All cold, rough people are round. All white people are cold. If someone is cold then they are furry. All furry, green people are rough. All round, green people are cold.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Harry is not white.

Nice($x, True) >>> Round($x, True) ::: Nice people are round.

Cold($x, True) >>> White($x, True) ::: All cold people are white.

Round($x, True) && Green($x, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: All round, green people are cold.

Query:
White(Harry, False) ::: Harry is not white.
